timing_source: Actual recording WordBoundary; punctuation tokens have no fabricated cue

audio/en/agree.mp3.text: Do we all agree? We can suggest a change.

audio/en/help.mp3.text: Let us ask our grown-up for help and say what we need.

audio/en/intro.mp3.text: We both want the truck. Let us listen and try a plan.

audio/en/needA.mp3.text: I would like to play with the truck. May I have a turn?

audio/en/needB.mp3.text: I would like a turn too. Let us find a plan that works for us.

audio/en/pause.mp3.text: Let us take a break. We can return when we are ready.

audio/en/review.mp3.text: What happened? Shall we keep our plan or change it?

audio/en/saved.mp3.text: Our plan is saved. We can come back to it.

audio/en/solutions.mp3.text: Let us look at two plans. Which one would we like to try?

audio/en/together.mp3.text: We play together. I build the road and you drive the truck.

audio/en/trial.mp3.text: Now let us try our plan with a toy or puppets.

audio/en/turns.mp3.text: We take turns. I play, then pass the truck to you.

audio/en/ball-pass-intro.mp3.text: Let us hear both requests and try a plan. A gentle ball pass.

audio/en/ball-pass-needA.mp3.text: I want the ball to reach me.

audio/en/ball-pass-needB.mp3.text: I want to send it gently.

audio/en/ball-pass-together.mp3.text: Say your partner’s name and wait until ready.

audio/en/ball-pass-turns.mp3.text: Sit facing each other and roll in turns.

audio/en/block-bridge-intro.mp3.text: Let us hear both requests and try a plan. Build a bridge.

audio/en/block-bridge-together.mp3.text: One builds the base and one the road, then test.

audio/en/block-bridge-turns.mp3.text: Build two low bridges, test the car, then choose.

audio/en/book-choice-intro.mp3.text: Let us hear both requests and try a plan. Choosing a book.

audio/en/book-choice-together.mp3.text: One chooses today and the other next session.

audio/en/book-choice-turns.mp3.text: Choose and read a page from each with a grown-up.

audio/en/change-rule-intro.mp3.text: Let us hear both requests and try a plan. Adjust a rule that does not work.

audio/en/change-rule-needA.mp3.text: I need time to understand my turn.

audio/en/change-rule-needB.mp3.text: I want the game to keep going.

audio/en/change-rule-together.mp3.text: Try two unhurried turns then ask about changes.

audio/en/change-rule-turns.mp3.text: The leader gives a cue and waits until the player is ready.

audio/en/fair-materials-intro.mp3.text: Let us hear both requests and try a plan. Enough materials for our project.

audio/en/fair-materials-needA.mp3.text: I need pieces for my tower.

audio/en/fair-materials-needB.mp3.text: I need pieces for my house.

audio/en/fair-materials-together.mp3.text: Design a shared house and tower with agreed roles.

audio/en/fair-materials-turns.mp3.text: Explain each project’s needs, share, then review.

audio/en/group-game-intro.mp3.text: Let us hear both requests and try a plan. A game for our group.

audio/en/group-game-together.mp3.text: Copy a movement, let others guess, then swap leader.

audio/en/group-game-turns.mp3.text: Hear every player and try one short round of each idea.

audio/en/hint-both.mp3.text: Use Look and listen on the highlighted plan to explore it.

audio/en/hint-consent.mp3.text: Ask every player, then confirm agreement in the highlighted box.

audio/en/hint-listen.mp3.text: After hearing and acting out the request, select the highlighted confirmation box.

audio/en/hint-plan.mp3.text: Choose one of the two highlighted plan cards.

audio/en/hint-reflection.mp3.text: Choose what happened after trying from the highlighted buttons.

audio/en/hint-rule.mp3.text: Write or dictate your play rule in the highlighted box.

audio/en/hint-trial.mp3.text: Try your plan away from the screen, then select the highlighted confirmation box.

audio/en/picture-space-intro.mp3.text: Let us hear both requests and try a plan. Space on our picture.

audio/en/picture-space-needA.mp3.text: I want space for my house.

audio/en/picture-space-needB.mp3.text: I want space for my tree.

audio/en/picture-space-together.mp3.text: Both choose where the house and tree fit together.

audio/en/picture-space-turns.mp3.text: Agree on each drawing’s space before starting.

audio/en/puppet-story-intro.mp3.text: Let us hear both requests and try a plan. A puppet story ending.

audio/en/puppet-story-needA.mp3.text: I want the puppet to visit the sea.

audio/en/puppet-story-needB.mp3.text: I want it to visit the forest.

audio/en/puppet-story-together.mp3.text: Agree on the order and act out visiting both.

audio/en/puppet-story-turns.mp3.text: Each acts out an ending, then choose one to try.

audio/en/quiet-loud-intro.mp3.text: Let us hear both requests and try a plan. Play and quiet.

audio/en/quiet-loud-needA.mp3.text: I want to play a rhythm.

audio/en/quiet-loud-together.mp3.text: A grown-up helps choose quiet and gentle-sound spaces.

audio/en/quiet-loud-turns.mp3.text: Agree on two short times and ask before sound.

audio/en/red-pencil-intro.mp3.text: Let us hear both requests and try a plan. Sharing the red pencil.

audio/en/red-pencil-needA.mp3.text: I want the pencil to draw an apple.

audio/en/red-pencil-needB.mp3.text: I want it to draw a flower.

audio/en/red-pencil-together.mp3.text: Draw the apple and flower on one shared sheet.

audio/en/red-pencil-turns.mp3.text: Each player draws one shape then passes the pencil.

audio/en/same-truck-intro.mp3.text: Let us hear both requests and try a plan. The same toy.

audio/en/same-truck-needA.mp3.text: I want to play with the truck.

audio/en/same-truck-together.mp3.text: One builds and one drives, then swap.

audio/en/same-truck-turns.mp3.text: Pass the truck after one short trip.

audio/en/shop-roles-intro.mp3.text: Let us hear both requests and try a plan. Shop roles.

audio/en/shop-roles-needA.mp3.text: I want to be the seller.

audio/en/shop-roles-needB.mp3.text: I want to be the seller too.

audio/en/shop-roles-together.mp3.text: Each player has a shop and visits the other.

audio/en/shop-roles-turns.mp3.text: Buy one card then swap seller and buyer.

audio/en/team-cleanup-intro.mp3.text: Let us hear both requests and try a plan. A plan to finish together.

audio/en/team-cleanup-needA.mp3.text: I want to finish what I built.

audio/en/team-cleanup-needB.mp3.text: I want us to tidy the space.

audio/en/team-cleanup-together.mp3.text: Agree on one small part to finish, then tidy and plan a return.

audio/en/team-cleanup-turns.mp3.text: Sketch what we want to continue, then share manageable tidy jobs.

audio/en/team-map-intro.mp3.text: Let us hear both requests and try a plan. A team treasure map.

audio/en/team-map-needA.mp3.text: I want to draw the route.

audio/en/team-map-needB.mp3.text: I want to choose the symbols.

audio/en/team-map-together.mp3.text: Each adds one mark and explains it to the group.

audio/en/team-map-turns.mp3.text: Agree on drawing, reading and symbols, then swap.

audio/en/tidy-toys-intro.mp3.text: Let us hear both requests and try a plan. Putting toys away.

audio/en/tidy-toys-needA.mp3.text: I want to collect the blocks.

audio/en/tidy-toys-needB.mp3.text: I want to collect the dolls.

audio/en/tidy-toys-together.mp3.text: Carry one toy at a time and swap placing it.

audio/en/tidy-toys-turns.mp3.text: Each player puts one type in a box.
